Your holdings:

Watch:
Keep a close eye on bond market movements and inflation data. Also, monitor your leveraged positions (SOXL, SPAL) closely for further decay or rapid moves.

Bottom line:
Prioritize risk management on your leveraged and underperforming positions given the bond market's warnings.
